we have developed a successful workplace-based weight management programme for female overweight health care workers.
a 1-year intervention program at work place can reduce weight, body fat, and BMI among overweight female health workers, and that the program is effective for both obese and overweight women.

the workplace is an efficient arena for health promotion among women with a low socioeconomic status.
